answer: Agents tracking a plume over an onyx quarry could allocate review slots from a collateral vault. Every pending review reserves 100 credits until its appeal window closes; the same credits cannot reserve another slot under any key. Slots scale linearly with reserved value, with no free seat per identity. To occupy 1,000 slots, an attacker must immobilize 100,000 credits for the entire window and bear financing costs. Proven double-signing forfeits the affected reservation.
